notablePrerequisites: You control at least one basic land.
description:
Activate a basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Obscuring Aether by paying {1}{G}, turning it face-down as a 2/2 creature.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Obscuring Aether, untapping the basic land.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Obscuring Aether, adding {G}.
When Obscuring Aether dies, Yarus' second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down, then turning it face-up.
Repeat.

uses.name: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods
